stem: Yash measures the heights of three plants as $12$ cm, $18$ cm, and $9$ cm. The graph shows the display he is planning for plants A, B, and C.

options.text: Call the finished picture a vertical column label only.
Say that choosing upward columns is what creates the three plant heights $12$, $18$, and $9$.
Use upward columns so taller plants read as taller bars, matching how height is measured.
Pick the largest printed number $18$ alone and treat that single number as the finished display.

teacher.key_rationale: Height is a vertical measurement, so upward columns make taller plants look taller. Naming only the column label substitutes a term for the fit. Saying the display creates the heights reverses the relation. Picking the largest print is surface capture.
teacher.figure_note: figure add: upward bar display of plant heights
